blocks.text: Mutlaq (absolute) electrode potentials nahi nape ja sakte kyunke jab element us ke ions ke solution mein rakha jaye to electrical double layer ban jati hai. Jab zinc zinc ions wale solution mein rakha jaye to satah ke bohat thore zinc atoms zinc ions mein badal kar solution mein jate hain, zinc ki satah par electrons ki zyadati chhorte hue. Metal ke ird-gird solution mein ab Zn2+ ions zyada hain, aur satah ke qareeb in cations mein se kuch us ki taraf khinchte hain, to electrical double layer banti hai. Charge ka yeh jama hona metal aur solution ke metal ions ke darmiyan electric potential (voltage) paida karta hai (Figure 10.3).

blocks.alt: Zinc rod ZnSO4 (aq) mein dooba hai. Solution ke andar rod ki dono satahon par manfi charges (electrons) hain, aur har taraf un ke saamne +2 wale gol nishanon ki qataar hai jis par 'Zinc(II) ions' likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.3: Electrical double layer ka banna (kitab ki Figure 10.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Double layer ki wajah se potential seedha nahi napa ja sakta, magar metal/metal ion system aur kisi doosre system ke darmiyan potential ka farq napa ja sakta hai. Yeh qeemat electrode potential, E, hai, volts mein; muqable ke liye standard hydrogen electrode (SHE) istemal hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Wazahat karein ke electrical double layer kaise aur kyun banti hai (exercise Q.2a).
blocks.explanation: Satah ke chand metal atoms electrons kho kar cations ke taur par solution mein jate hain; electrons metal par rehte hain, us ki satah ko manfi banate hue, aur cations wapas khinch kar us satah ke saath lagte hain. Metal par electrons ki tah solution mein cations ki tah ke samne double layer hai, aur alag hua charge potential ka farq deta hai jis ki mutlaq qeemat napi nahi ja sakti, sirf doosre electrode se muqabla ho sakta hai.

items: Zn2+ solution mein zinc: chand atoms ions ke taur par halte hain, metal par zyada electrons chhorte hue; cations satah par jama hote hain: electrical double layer aur potential.
Mutlaq potentials nape nahi ja sakte; reference, SHE, se farq electrode potential E volts mein hai.
